purpose: Vehicle-scoped lifetime recorded charging versus modeled gasoline operating-cost evidence, supplemented by an owner-recorded fixed-cost ledger and opt-in Helix narration.
primaryGoal: Understand measured versus modeled costs, savings or losses, source coverage and assumptions without mistaking an operating-cost comparison for verified complete ownership cost; inspect/export evidence and record or delete fixed costs.

dataSources.name: useCostBreakdown
dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped analyticsKeys.cost query, enabled only with a vehicle; forwards AbortSignal. No page date range: explicitly lifetime envelope. Pure analyzeTrueCost validates the unmodified payload and independently validates monthly fields.
dataSources.limits: Frontend source explicitly describes legacy aggregate kilometres and watt-hours, configured price/unit and MPG. Backend computations, currency aggregation and actual responses were not inspected or exercised; do not silently migrate these wire fields during presentation work.

dataSources.name: Fixed-cost ledger query and mutations
dataSources.behavior: Independent vehicle-keyed query with AbortSignal. Mutation success invalidates and broadcasts the vehicle ledger key; existing success/error toasts remain. Preserve category, amount, incurred date, note, entry IDs, currency metadata and totals.
dataSources.limits: No mutations executed; backend persistence, mixed-currency behavior and authorization unverified.

dataSources.name: Helix narration
dataSources.behavior: Body vehicle_id; vehicle identity is stream scopeKey. Feature HOC gates tco-narration; AIFeatureCard receives stream, buttonLabel, canStart, localized description and no-vehicle hint. Deterministic sections remain independent.
dataSources.limits: Route registration/source wiring only, not a successful SSE request or proof of feature-gate/runtime cancellation.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle and display preferences
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned vehicle; gas-unit preference is fallback only after response gas_unit. Existing useUnits/useFormatting and locale/precision mechanisms format at display boundary.
dataSources.limits: Global providers/hooks were not expanded; saved preference and shell behavior not runtime verified.

components.name: TrueCostLayoutSlot
components.behavior: Forwards single CardGrid placement span and min-w-0 through existing FadeIn, without another surface or packing engine.

components.name: OperationalBrief
components.behavior: useOperationalMetrics adapts source numeric values with specialist display formatters, preserved missing values and source descriptions.

components.name: ChartContainer and category chart renderers
components.behavior: All five charts pass source-derived data and accessible data-column definitions; two pass persisted chartKey/hiddenSeries. Actual toolbar/exports/fullscreen accessibility not tested.

components.name: DataTable
components.behavior: Stable tableIds present. Existing mobilePresentation and expansion APIs should be reused to retain currently hidden details/actions, not replaced with a second table implementation.

components.name: Source presentation and query trust
components.behavior: Existing GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, Table, Badge, Code, EmptyState, Skeleton, QueryError, AlertBanner and Button retain source-specific sections, semantics and trust states.

components.name: AITCONarration / AIFeatureCard
components.kind: existing shared AI surface with page-specific narration

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Barrel continues exporting older EvidenceLedger, SavingsEnvelope and FixedLedger implementations while the mounted page explicitly imports operationalbrief-n-z and true-cost-modernization versions. This is source-level competing ownership, not proof that the older versions mount elsewhere.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Designate the mounted domain owners and reconcile barrel exports/callers in a separately owned integration change; do not delete alternate implementations until consumer and preservation evidence is established.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Assumptions, source-scope and temporal-coverage render analogous labeled evidence rows with the existing Table/Text pipeline; domain rows and distinct content remain necessary.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing Table/typography now. Only extend a shared key/value presentation after cross-consumer proof; do not create a speculative new renderer or merge away domain explanations.

observed: Single allocated-width CardGrid with 11 full and 6 half slots; min-w-0 placement/motion adapter.
Panel paddings use p-4 sm:p-5; disclosures and break-even reflow at md; accounting at lg.
Fixed ledger entry form is grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5; charts use ResponsiveContainer and explicit frame heights.

issues.detail: mobileColumns includes only date/category/amount. DataTable.tsx:725 applies hidden md:table-cell to note and actions. No mobilePresentation or expansion is supplied, so the source has no alternate mobile delete or note-detail path.
issues.fix: Reuse existing DataTable mobilePresentation or accessible expansion to retain note, currency context and delete action at narrow widths while keeping desktop columns and persistence.

issues.detail: Only source/month/disposition survive the mobile allow-list; six numeric evidence columns lack a mobile detail path. SensitivityMatrix.tsx:120 similarly hides highMpg while columnVisibility is disabled at line 114.
issues.fix: Use the same existing DataTable mobile detail/expansion owner for all source evidence and all nine scenarios; retain ordering, filters, pagination and tableIds.

accessibility.status: source-only; keyboard, focus, screen-reader, touch-target, forced-color and contrast acceptance unverified
observed: Localized section/chart aria labels and descriptions; semantic table row headers in evidence matrices.
Chart dataColumns provide data alternatives at caller level; actual controls untested.
Input/Select/Button/ConfirmDialog are shared primitives; delete has a localized aria-label and decorative icon aria-hidden.

issues.detail: Five-column form begins at sm while the parent ledger has limited allocated width; narrow targets and long translated labels need real viewport/text-zoom verification. Source alone cannot establish clipping or touch failure.
issues.fix: Exercise all contract widths, 200% text, long labels and RTL; adjust this form's responsive composition only if measured, keeping all fields and independent business date.

observed: Main query distinguishes no vehicle, initial loading, unresolved/pending, initial pause, fatal failure, retained refresh failure, retained paused refresh, refreshing, valid zero and malformed envelope.
TrueCostSectionBody retains section framing and source placeholders, without globally hiding all page content.
Boundary and methodology remain visible independently of data availability.
Charts gate data/export readiness and show per-chart empty states; valid negative deltas remain losses.
Fixed ledger preserves retained entries on refresh failure but has weaker independent-query trust and missing-input handling than the main cost model.
Helix gates optional UI and carries vehicle-scoped stream identity; no runtime state proof.

issues.detail: Raw missing main-query totals are defaulted to zero for the independent FixedLedger. FixedLedger.tsx:70-71 also substitutes zero for unavailable ledger totals and renders all-in cost in the header at lines 116-121 even during initial loading/fatal error/no vehicle. Main-query partial or malformed values bypass analyzeTrueCost's null validation here.
issues.fix: Keep nullable validated totals and source availability through the fixed-ledger presentation contract; show unknown or retained evidence until both numerator sources and positive distance are supported. Preserve a real measured zero distinctly.

issues.detail: Ledger rendering branches on loading and fatal/refresh error, not fetchStatus, initial/retained pause or vehicle absence. Disabled/unresolved ledger data can fall through to an empty-entry message and zero-total hint; offline semantics are not equivalent to the main query adapter.
issues.fix: Reuse the existing query/data-state policy for this independent source, preserving cached rows and adding truthful no-vehicle, paused, unresolved and retry states without blocking neighboring charts.

issues.detail: Delete mutation is wired with pending and success handling, but only addMutation.isError has an inline ErrorText at lines 169-174. Delete failure currently depends on the shared mutation toast rather than persistent dialog feedback.
issues.fix: Retain existing mutation toast and confirmation; surface delete failure and retry without closing the pending entry or losing input.

visualIssues.detail: Feature-local saturated cyan/rose hex palette overrides shared semantic chart ownership. EnergyCostTrend.tsx:22-23 repeats cyan with purple; MonthlyDeltaChart.tsx:21 uses amber; CumulativeChart.tsx:20 uses indigo. These are source color literals, not measured contrast or screenshots.
visualIssues.fix: Map existing series identities through the canonical chart palette/tokens, preserve configured theme/chart choices and all series/legends/export identities; avoid new palette or glow.

visualIssues.detail: Fixed emerald-300, rose-300 and amber-300 presentation classes carry semantic signs but bypass theme-resolving semantic tokens. FixedLedger.tsx:113 also uses cyan-300 icon decoration. Light-theme contrast is unmeasured; do not call it a proven contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse severity/text tokens while retaining signed numerical values and badge labels; verify composed backgrounds in supported themes.

architectureIssues.detail: Select option labels display raw category codes; ledger columns likewise display e.category at TrueCostLedgerColumns.tsx:25. These are system enumerations rather than arbitrary user notes and are not localized.
architectureIssues.fix: Localize display labels with existing catalog ownership; retain category wire values and filter identities unchanged. Report missing keys to the catalog owner rather than editing catalogs in page scope.

architectureIssues.detail: Fixed-ledger all-in rate and lifetime hint always display /km and km, unlike useTrueCostDisplay's selected display distance in the analytical charts. AccountingIdentities.tsx:35 intentionally exposes source currency_per_km checks and should not be blindly converted.
architectureIssues.fix: Apply existing selected-distance display formatting to user-facing fixed-ledger rates/hints while explicitly retaining source-unit accounting identity semantics and unchanged wire/export values.

priority.rationale: Prioritize missing-versus-zero all-in totals and mobile detail/delete reachability; then independent ledger trust, ownership reconciliation, localization and restrained chart palette adoption. Existing 17-section composition is substantially shared; no wholesale redesign warranted.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical chart palette adoption mapping
requiredSharedChanges.change: Verify and reuse the existing palette described by MDC-034; no new shared palette API or implementation is established as necessary by this audit.
props: series identity to semantic palette mapping
requiredSharedChanges.limits: Owner path is contract-cited; palette internals not inspected. No speculative shared extension authorized.

sectionNames: Monthly recorded EV vs modeled gas
actions: Header-owned vehicle selection without adding local duplicate controls.
Main-query fatal retry and retained refresh retry via TrueCostQueryStatus.
Five chart exports retain filenames and raw source/derived column identities; accessible data views remain supplied.
Monthly cost and energy chart persisted series visibility keys: true-cost-monthly-cost and true-cost-energy-cost.
Monthly directory value filters, pagination 12/24/48, source row ordering/identities, stable analytics:true-cost-monthly-evidence tableId.
Sensitivity table stable analytics:true-cost-sensitivity identity and all nine scenarios.
Fixed-ledger sorting, value filters, pagination and stable analytics:tco-fixed-ledger tableId.

Record cost with eight category wire values, positive amount, incurred business date, optional trimmed note; default insurance and UTC-derived initial date remain source behavior, not a workspace range.
Delete entry through confirmation with pending state and cancel; ledger query retry; mutation success/error toasts and invalidation/broadcast.
Opt-in Explain ownership cost Helix narration with current feature gate, no-vehicle disabling, vehicle-scoped stream and unchanged deterministic evidence.
dataBehavior: Lifetime vehicle aggregate remains separate from independent fixed-cost ledger and optional narrative; do not add date filtering unsupported by the inspected hook.
Preserve response/settings gas-unit fallback, locale, global number precision, source currency and display distance/energy preferences.
Keep missing, malformed, zero, negative loss, partial support and retained data distinct.
Preserve original monthly source order in directory; eligible unique YYYY-MM rows sort chronologically for charts; duplicates/invalid rows remain inspectable rather than silently removed.
Keep derived gas-minus-EV and cumulative deltas separately from API savings/cumulative columns and exports.

Retain positive-cost charging versus positive-drive scope disclosures, monthly energy-derived gas caveat, maintenance heuristic, exclusions, calendar/timezone limits, coverage gaps, thresholds, scenario factors and tolerance checks.
Retain legacy aggregate kilometre/rate fields and Wh untouched in wire/cache; no guessed SI cutover or backend capability changes.
Do not hide boundary or methodology on loading/error; do not erase existing entries on refresh failure; repair unknown-total rendering without fabricating zero.
preservation.countLimits: Source-only counts for assigned orchestrator, not a clean dependency/theme audit. No historical page baseline comparison or runtime section-count assertion.

evidenceLimits: Atomic source audit only. Both route strings are assignment identities, not verified mounted navigation.
No source edits, Git, production requests/mutations, browser screenshots, viewport rendering, full lint/build, TypeScript or tests executed.

Violations skill script inspected but not run because it unconditionally executes project TypeScript; assignment and worker conventions prohibit project-wide validation during this audit. Page-only regex counts were executed instead.
Source hash and page line count measured directly. Exact runtime/visual/contrast/keyboard/focus/motion/RTL/theme/forced-color/export/SSE claims remain unverified.
Only directly relevant presentation/data owners and targeted router registrations inspected. Shared layout, palette, AI stream, formatter/provider and backend calculations not recursively audited.

Large initial combined terminal reads were truncated by the tool; substantive mounted presentation files were subsequently reread through bounded direct views/commands. Alternate implementations intentionally inspected only stated leading ranges.

No fixture data or prior acceptance receipts used. Backend filter/calculation descriptions are frontend disclosure evidence, not independent backend proof.
